summary: High-frequency plaque annihilation. An aerospace-grade, matte black sonic toothbrush engineered for maximum physical disruption of dental biofilms.
description: Kinetic oral engineering. Delivering 40,000 micro-vibrations per minute, this tool physically shatters plaque architecture and forces fluids deep into interdental spaces for a clinical-grade clean.
technical_overview: Offered at $95.0 for 1 Unit, this KoColor TOOTHBRUSH is expertly constructed with a Matte Aluminum Handle and Dupont Nylon Bristles. It delivers a high-fidelity Matte Obsidian color profile (`#0F0F0F`) and leverages high-frequency kinetic cavitation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Guide the brush head slowly across each quadrant of the mouth, applying zero manual pressure.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Hold the brush at a precise 45-degree angle to the gum line to allow the sonic waves to clean the subgingival pocket.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Bristles are laser-rounded at the microscopic level to prevent micro-abrasions to the delicate gum tissue.
